title: AIID 1158: Wiper prompt injected into the Amazon Q Developer extension shipped in a public release
summary: The AI Incident Database records that a malicious instruction inserted into the Amazon Q Developer extension for Visual Studio Code (release v1.84.0) could, if executed, have wiped users' local files and affected cloud resources. The altered code was included in a public release before AWS detected and removed it, and AWS published security bulletin AWS-2025-015 on 2025-07-23.
verification_note: AIID page fetched 2026-10-17. Incident date 2025-07-17, release v1.84.0, bulletin AWS-2025-015 (dated 2025-07-23) and the claim that the altered code reached a public release before detection are all on the page. The page states the command could have wiped files if executed and reports no realised harm, so kind is near-miss rather than incident.
